<!-- pr-reviewer: bb0725ba844eee9cbb24ee397a6ed07c43db831a -->
Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

I reviewed this head locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `61a817bed26bf42bf285638d5db337980bea6d0b`. No GitHub runner ran.

What looks good:

- The thinning step keeps the window ends and selects existing curve samples. The added error bound fits the callers' tolerance budget.
- All five new spacing tests pass. Both reported mutations fail as expected.
- I checked all four changed NC goldens line by line. All 516 removed lines are feed blocks on straight, monotone Z moves. The X words and feed rates stay the same across each removed run. No other command changes.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **failed**. It completed all 641 steps in 59.6 minutes. One suite failed. The other 640 steps passed.
- Builds with `--no-run`: passed for the selected post, motion, and app targets.
- CL: 3 tests passed.
- Post: 407 tests passed across 38 suites.
- Motion: 511 tests passed; 10 ignored. This includes the library (487), `turning_bore` (11), `turning_offset_spacing` (5), and `turning_prof` (8).
- App: 3,973 tests passed; 2 failed; 48 ignored across 595 suites.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The failed suite is `example_catalog` (3 passed, 2 failed):

```text
every_catalog_case_opens_regenerates_verifies_and_posts_byte_for_byte
crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:198:9
assertion `left == right` failed: turning/cone-thread: regenerated NC differs

every_catalog_case_rebuilds_from_camscript
crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:257:9
assertion `left == right` failed: turning/cone-thread: build.camscript NC differs from committed .nc
```

**Extra suites run**

The fixture search found the changed NC consumers. All ran in the quick gate, including `lathe_post` (7 passed), `lathe_post_inch` (6 passed), and `lathe_post_tormach` (8 passed). The other selected lathe-post suites passed too. All 595 app suites and the 38 selected post suites ran, so the fixture readers were not omitted. The diff changes no importer or STEP fixture. The extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

**Mutations**

I compiled temporary copies of the offset module with the PR's exact new test file. A small harness supplied the error enum. No worktree source changed.

- Original offset routine: red. The OD, ID, and window-end spacing tests fail. The OD gap is `4.440892098500626e-16`; the ID gap is `1.1102230246251565e-16`.
- Tail give-way disabled: red. The window-end test fails with a gap of `1.0000000005838672e-7`.
- PR routine before and after the mutations: green, all 5 tests. The Cargo suite also passes all 5 tests.

**Requested before merge**

1. `examples/catalog/turning/cone-thread/cone-thread.nc:70` — Refresh and review the catalog NC output for the new spacing rule. This example is on current upstream main. Its regeneration produces 732 lines against 1,197 committed lines: 465 `G01` lines are removed and none are added. Both catalog round-trip tests fail. Update the affected example artifacts as needed. Run `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` again. Correct the PR body's statement that this example is not on main.
2. `crates/motion/src/turning/offset.rs:137` / PR body, “Not exercised” — Run the full reached heavy gate on the final head. Current upstream AGENTS.md, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires this before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects 234 steps across motion and app. The body states that the full reach did not run. The reported 16-binary subset does not cover that reach. Record the reached lanes and their results in the body. I ran the plan only; these heavy results remain unverified.

The PR merges cleanly, but these two items block `merge-ready`. No UI files change, so screenshots are not required. The PR stays a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
